import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    a = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(3)]
    b = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(3)]

    max_wins = 0
    min_non_wins = 0

    for i in range(3):
        win_add = min(a[i], b[(i+1) % 3])
        max_wins += win_add

        lose_maybe = min(b[i], a[(i+1) % 3])
        draw_maybe = min(b[i], a[i])
        s = lose_maybe + draw_maybe
        cycle_lose = min(b[i], s)
        min_non_wins += cycle_lose

    print(f"{n - min_non_wins} {max_wins}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
